description: Finding a meeting time and creating a draft meeting from a slot.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam; now is 2026-11-18 10:00.
An is an active Meeting Organizer; Binh is an active user with an Effective Level1 share to An covering November.
Binh is free the whole of Monday 2026-11-23.
cases.inputs: actor: An; search: userIds [Binh], includeMe false, duration 60, 2026-11-23 to 2026-11-23, work 08:00-17:00, lunch 12:00-13:00, buffer 0, step 30.
cases.return: Kind AllFree with 14 slots in time order (starts 08:00 to 11:00 and 13:00 to 16:00); people [Binh Shared with Level1 and its dates]; no code. No notification or audit row is written.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam; now is 2026-11-18 10:00.
An is an active Meeting Organizer; Binh and Cuong are active users with Effective shares to An covering November.
On Monday 2026-11-23 Binh is busy 08:00-12:00 and Cuong is busy 13:00-17:00, so no slot fits everyone.
cases.inputs: actor: An; search: userIds [Binh, Cuong] with the base day, duration 60 and buffer 0.
cases.return: Kind MostFree with the slots the most people are free for (freeCount 1 of 2) listing who is busy; the endpoint answers 200 with code MSG445 ("Không có khung giờ nào hợp với tất cả. Đang hiện các khung nhiều người dự được nhất.").

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam.
An is an active Meeting Organizer; Binh is an active user with no open share to An.
includeMe is false, so nobody is counted.
cases.inputs: actor: An; search: userIds [Binh] with the base day and duration 60.
cases.return: Kind None; days empty; people [Binh NotShared with no level or dates]; no code.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam.
An is an active user without the Meeting Organizer right.
cases.inputs: actor: An; search: userIds [Binh] with the base day and duration 60.
cases.return: Failure NotOrganizer; the endpoint answers 403 MSG448 ("Bạn cần quyền tạo cuộc họp để thực hiện thao tác này."); nothing is read.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam.
An is an active Meeting Organizer.
cases.inputs: actor: An; search: userIds [An] (the finder invites themselves).
cases.return: Failure InvalidSearch; errors.userIds is "Chọn từ 1 đến 10 người, không trùng và không chọn chính mình."; the endpoint answers 400 MSG444 ("Thông tin tìm giờ họp không hợp lệ. Kiểm tra các trường được đánh dấu.").

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam.
An is an active Meeting Organizer; Binh was deactivated after sharing.
Otherwise valid search with userIds [Binh].
cases.inputs: actor: An; search: userIds [Binh] with the base day and duration 60.
cases.return: Failure InvalidSearch; errors.userIds[0] is "Người dùng không tồn tại hoặc đã ngừng hoạt động."; the endpoint answers 400 MSG444.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam.
An is an active Meeting Organizer.
cases.inputs: actor: An; search: userIds [Binh] with durationMinutes 10.
cases.return: Failure InvalidSearch; errors.durationMinutes is "Thời lượng từ 15 phút đến 8 giờ, bội số của 5 phút."; the endpoint answers 400 MSG444.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam.
An is an active Meeting Organizer.
cases.inputs: actor: An; search: userIds [Binh] with durationMinutes 480 and lunchBreak true.
cases.return: Failure InvalidSearch; errors.durationMinutes is "Thời lượng dài hơn một buổi làm việc. Rút ngắn hoặc bỏ nghỉ trưa."; the endpoint answers 400 MSG444.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam.
An is an active Meeting Organizer.
cases.inputs: actor: An; search: userIds [Binh] with fromDate 2026-11-10 (in the past).
cases.return: Failure InvalidSearch; errors.fromDate is "Ngày bắt đầu từ hôm nay đến tối đa 365 ngày sau."; the endpoint answers 400 MSG444.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam.
An is an active Meeting Organizer.
cases.inputs: actor: An; search: fromDate 2026-11-23 with toDate 2026-11-20 (before the start).
cases.return: Failure InvalidSearch; errors.toDate is "Khoảng ngày tối đa 31 ngày, ngày kết thúc không trước ngày bắt đầu."; the endpoint answers 400 MSG444.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam.
An is an active Meeting Organizer.
cases.inputs: actor: An; search: userIds [Binh] with stepMinutes 7.
cases.return: Failure InvalidSearch; errors.stepMinutes is "Làm tròn giờ bắt đầu từ 5 phút đến 2 giờ, bội số của 5 phút."; the endpoint answers 400 MSG444.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam; now is 2026-11-18 10:00.
An is an active Meeting Organizer; 10 active users share Effective calendars with An.
Everyone is free on Monday 2026-11-23.
cases.inputs: actor: An; search: 10 userIds, duration 15, buffer 0, step 5, the base day.
cases.return: Failure None with the found slots; 10 invitees, the most allowed, are accepted.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam; now is 2026-11-18 10:00.
An is an active Meeting Organizer; Binh shares an Effective calendar and is free every weekday.
The range 2026-11-23 to 2026-12-23 holds far more than 200 slots.
cases.inputs: actor: An; search: userIds [Binh], duration 15, step 5, lunchBreak false, 2026-11-23 to 2026-12-23.
cases.return: Kind AllFree; 200 slots in time order; truncated true.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam.
An is an active Meeting Organizer.
The database fails while reading the shares and invitees.
cases.inputs: actor: An; search: userIds [Binh] with the base day and duration 60.
cases.return: Failure ReadFailed; the endpoint answers 500 MSG453 ("Không tải được dữ liệu chia sẻ lịch. Vui lòng thử lại."); nothing is returned.
cases.log: Error logged with the actor id.
